name: bash
arguments:
{"command":"python3 - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
import csv, io
pay='''record_id,regular_hours,overtime_hours,hourly_rate,deduction
EMP-001,159,7,31.19,202
EMP-002,145,6,27.4,165
EMP-003,158,7,42.76,168
EMP-004,130,9,23.1,138
EMP-005,144,4,23.06,173
EMP-006,148,9,40.39,174
EMP-007,154,10,32.54,138
EMP-008,150,2,36.51,231
EMP-009,156,8,45.9,191
EMP-010,143,6,32.84,207
'''
D=Decimal; q=D('0.01'); m=D('1.73'); w=D('0.2137')
s1=D(0);s2=D(0)
for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(pay)):
    gross=D(r['regular_hours'])*D(r['hourly_rate'])+D(r['overtime_hours'])*D(r['hourly_rate'])*m
    gr=gross.quantize(q, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    net1=(gross*(1-w)-D(r['deduction'])).quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    net2=(gr*(1-w)-D(r['deduction'])).quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    print(r['record_id'], 'g',gross, gr,'net_unrg',net1,'net_rg',net2)
    s1+=net1;s2+=net2
print('totals',s1,s2)
PY"}
